title: OUCH!!!
description: Make magma realistic and actually deal a little damage while holding.
body:
### What is OUCH!!!?
This plugin makes magma more realistic by dealing a small amount of damage while you are holding it. Thats it, just makes magma more realistic and fills in the holes of where is doesn't make sense.

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
